judged_text: The slug spread condition is inverted by this diff: the old code wrote slug when IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED is false (`...(!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { slug })`), the new ternary writes it only when it is true, while the adjacent requestedSlug line keeps the original semantics. On deployments where IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED is false (self-hosted default), organization creation no longer persists slug, so newly created organizations have no URL identifier and are broken until manually fixed; on billing-enabled deployments slug is now written pre-payment, changing the paid-onboarding gating. This drive-by change is also unrelated to the destinationCalendar purpose of the PR.
